key_provisions_or_claims: Determines commencement date for the registration and accreditation regulations for remotely piloted and model aircraft
Notifiable instrument under the Civil Aviation Safety Amendment Regulations 2019
Supports drone registration and operator accreditation regime
annotation.summary_en: Australian notifiable commencement determination (31 March 2020) fixing when the Civil Aviation Safety Amendment (Remotely Piloted Aircraft and Model Aircraft — Registration and Accreditation) Regulations 2019 start, establishing drone and model aircraft registration and accreditation. Only metadata is shown.
